name: Penicillin V

fda.text: SERIOUS AND OCCASIONALLY FATAL HYPERSENSITIVITY (anaphylactic) REACTIONS HAVE BEEN REPORTED IN PATIENTS ON PENICILLIN THERAPY. THESE REACTIONS ARE MORE LIKELY TO OCCUR IN INDIVIDUALS WITH A HISTORY OF PENICILLIN HYPERSENSITIVITY AND/OR A HISTORY OF SENSITIVITY TO MULTIPLE ALLERGENS. THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF…

summary: Warnings for Penicillin V state that severe and sometimes deadly allergic reactions, known as anaphylactic reactions, have occurred in patients taking this medicine [3]. These dangerous reactions are more prone to happen in people who have past allergic responses to penicillin or multiple allergy triggers [3]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than human testing estimated a medium score for liver risk and a low score for heart risk [M].
